odc_type: Null Pointer Dereference due to improper return value handling
observation_summary: A NullPointerException is thrown when using Mockito matchers with methods that accept primitive types.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs because the matcher methods (isA, eq, same) were returning a hardcoded null value when registering matchers. When these matchers are used with primitive-type-accepting methods (like intArgumentMethod), the framework attempts to unbox the returned null value, resulting in a NullPointerException. The fix changes the return mechanism from returning a hardcoded null to returning a default value appropriate for the expected type (e.g., 0 for int, false for boolean), which prevents the unboxing failure.
